input:
Everyone is obsessed with megacap tech but I think the interesting move over the
   next year is small caps catching a bid as rates come down. Big tech is priced
   for perfection. I still want some index exposure because I might be early, but
   I want the tilt to be real.

thesis.title: Small Cap Rate Relief
thesis.summary: As rates decline, small caps stand to benefit disproportionately — they carry more floating-rate debt and have been starved of capital during the high-rate era. Megacap tech is priced for perfection; any stumble punishes it hard. The core holds SPY and QQQ for broad coverage in case this is early, but the real bet is on IWM catching a sustained bid as the rate environment shifts. The tilt to COIN adds a rate-sensitive, risk-on kicker that historically moves with small-cap sentiment.

holdings.rationale: The primary expression of the thesis. Small caps carry more variable-rate debt than large caps, so a falling-rate environment directly reduces their cost of capital. IWM is the cleanest, most liquid way to hold this view at scale.

Insurance against being early. If small caps lag and megacap continues to dominate, SPY captures enough of that return to prevent a catastrophic miss. Kept lean enough not to dilute the core small-cap bet.
Minimal tech exposure as a concession to the possibility that the AI trade still has legs. At 500 bps this is a hedge against being entirely wrong on megacap, not a conviction position.

Coinbase is a high-beta, rate-sensitive risk-on asset that historically correlates with small-cap sentiment rather than megacap. Falling rates and improved liquidity conditions tend to lift speculative and growth names like COIN alongside IWM.

AMD provides a mid-tier semiconductor tilt — less priced-for-perfection than NVDA, with more room to re-rate if broader market breadth expands. A proxy for the thesis that risk appetite spreads beyond the top five names.

Broadcom sits at the intersection of AI infrastructure and cyclical recovery. If rates fall and the economy lands softly, AVGO benefits from both enterprise spending re-acceleration and its exposure to custom silicon demand.

falsifier.claim: Small caps will outperform as rates fall. The thesis rests on the Federal Reserve delivering meaningful rate cuts within the next 12 months and that translating into IWM outperforming QQQ.
falsifier.observable: IWM total return vs QQQ total return, measured over the 12-month holding period. Fed funds rate trajectory as reported by FOMC meeting statements.
falsifier.breachCondition: If IWM underperforms QQQ by more than 5 percentage points over 12 months, or if the Fed delivers fewer than two 25bp cuts in the period, the thesis is broken.
